metadata.title: Current replacement UI workflow/action ledger
metadata.method: Static source audit plus bounded recorded evidence; no new native, Cargo, desktop or device runs.
metadata.interpretation: All mapped requirements remain open. Family routes identify current access or an audit starting point, never full requirement satisfaction. No completion percentage.
metadata.schema_discovery: No runtime native schema enumeration was run. Catalog preferred fields and all declared Rust task controls are audited; additional runtime fields/options remain explicit acceptance work.

acceptance_gates.G1: Review every documented desktop input, submode, selection type and dependency against an exact implementation. Record explicit native limits and agreed deviations.
acceptance_gates.G2: Actual editor creation and existing-feature editing, including conditional fields, units, expressions, manipulators and selection identities. A catalog entry is insufficient.
acceptance_gates.G3: Parent/reference/topology changes, moved coordinate frames, dependent recomputation and source isolation where required.
acceptance_gates.G4: Preview replacement, Cancel, invalid selection/value and solver failure recovery without unintended document or redo changes.
acceptance_gates.G5: Sketch-action and document Undo/Redo, Finish validation and Cancel on consumed profiles where applicable.
acceptance_gates.G6: Save to new native files, reopen in editor and independent native inspection of editable graph, exact links, constraints and analytical/authoritative geometry.
acceptance_gates.G7: Original/source file hash preservation, cross-platform behavior and representative native-baseline comparison. Report unsupported native cases rather than inventing success.
acceptance_gates.G8: Representative resource regression and reliability checks for the completed workflow. Keep quiescent resource facts separate from interaction latency and speed claims.

families.title: Local document lifecycle
prerequisites: Start the replacement editor with its existing opaque runtime configuration. Wait for Ready. Only one document is exposed at a time.
selection: No geometry selection is needed.
inputs: New; Open FCStd; Save; Save as; folder navigation; FCStd filter; destination filename; replace confirmation; unsaved Discard/Cancel confirmation.

steps.instruction: Choose New for an empty native document, or Open and pick an FCStd file. Cancel the file browser to abandon the request. If prompted about unsaved changes, Cancel returns to the current document; Discard permits replacement.

Save first opens Save as when no native path exists. Browse to a writable directory, enter a new FCStd filename and accept the browser. Confirm replacement only for an intentional existing destination. Ctrl+S saves; Ctrl+Shift+S opens Save as.
There is no modeling preview for New/Open/Save. A browser/confirmation is pending UI only; canceling it starts no native file operation.
Accept the selected file in the browser, or confirm Discard for a requested replacement. New/Open replace the exposed document only after native success. Save has no separate feature Apply button.
Cancel the file browser, overwrite or unsaved confirmation to retain the current document. Native writes already in flight cannot be canceled by closing a chooser.
Open an FCStd, then double-click an existing sketch/feature or select Properties. No document properties/branch editor is implied.

Edit a referenced parent through its existing task. Finish and recompute. Inspect downstream errors and native link ownership. Topology failure must restore the previous valid document; old edge/face numbers are not a persistent reference scheme.
Undo/Redo accepted native modeling edits, not file-browser navigation. Save changes revision but is not a replacement for model history. Verify unsaved state after document replacement.

Finish or cancel all tasks, Save as to a new FCStd path, then Open that path and repeat the existing-object edit. Native saved-file readback must inspect editable history, constraints, expressions, links and geometry for acceptance.

Keep the task and entered input after rejection where implemented. Correct the value or select a valid native reference and retry; otherwise Cancel. Refresh native state after rollback. If unavailable, use the explicit Close/discard confirmation; Cancel retains ownership and a failed Close permits retry.

Busy calls, another feature draft, sketch drag/dimension/task, support chooser or file browser can disable commands. Finish or cancel the owner and wait for Ready. Invalid selections show command-specific disabled hover reasons where implemented.

families.missing_operation: No multi-tab document UI, cloud document service, versions/branches/merge, explicit old .cadpart importer or cross-process locking contract.

families.title: Native picking and ordered selection
prerequisites: A Ready document with visible selectable geometry. Enter a sketch for sketch entities.
selection: Solid tree rows select whole native objects. Ctrl/Shift-click toggles additional tree objects.
View > Selection chooses Faces and edges, Faces, Edges or available Vertices. Click a visible native subelement; Shift adds/removes.

In a sketch click exposed point handles separately from whole curves; Shift adds/removes. Repeated Shift-clicks cycle coincident handles. Origin is a point; axes are whole native curves away from geometry.
Drag blank sketch space for a contained box; right-to-left also crosses curves. Shift adds the box. Selection order is retained by command construction.
Link-list fields have Up, Down, Remove, Add object and Use selection. Explicitly inspect this list for section, original and support order.
inputs: Selection filter; Shift/Ctrl; ordered native object/subelement list; no inferred detached mesh identities.

steps.instruction: Choose Select in a sketch, or a selection filter in View outside it.

Make one point/curve/edge/face/object pick at a time. Clear unwanted picks. Use a field selection button only after confirming its intended native owner. For singular generic fields Use selection currently takes the first selected link; clear all but one. Pad/Pocket targets instead reject multiple singular picks.
Hover/selection highlights are display feedback, not a native modeling candidate.
A pick updates selection immediately. There is no Apply for selection itself. The consuming task selection button copies native identities into its input.

Toggle a selected pick off with the additive modifier, clear selection with the relevant Select interaction, or abandon the consuming task. Escape ends active picking tools; it does not undo previously accepted sketch actions.
Replace the native picks and use the consuming field selection button again. Use Up/Down on lists to change order.
Refresh selections after native recompute/rollback/history. Never keep an old face/edge index as a substitute for a native saved link.
Selections themselves have no document Undo entry. Verify history through their consuming action.
Selection state is not a saved modeling operation. Verify that the consuming feature retains exact native links after FCStd reopen.

Keep the task and entered input after rejection where implemented. Correct the value or select a valid native reference and retry; otherwise Cancel. Refresh native state after rollback. families.title: Camera, display and visibility
prerequisites: Open a native document; Fit may be used on an empty model.
selection: Select owning objects or faces/edges before Hide selected/Show selected. Visibility operates on native owners.
inputs: Front, Back, Left, Right, Top, Bottom, Isometric; Fit all; Shaded, Shaded with edges, Wireframe; selection filters; Hide selected, Show selected, Show all.

steps.instruction: Right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, wheel to zoom. F fits; Iso uses the isometric direction.
Choose the View direction/display mode. Use explicit visibility actions outside an active modeling task. Reopen a sketch to align to its native frame.
Camera/display changes update presentation immediately and do not open a modeling preview.
Choose the view/display action directly. Show/Hide changes native owner visibility through explicit commands; there is no view Apply button.
Stop the navigation gesture or choose a different view/display mode. No camera-preview Cancel exists.
Choose another direction/display mode or Show/Hide action. Native Properties intentionally excludes Visibility from parameter previews.
Recompute native geometry then Fit. Check moved coordinate frames and displayed Body Tips without resurrecting hidden historical solids.
Native Visibility is Output/NoModify and does not create its own native Undo entry. Do not promise camera/visibility Undo from modeling transactions.
Save/reopen can check native visibility and displayed Body Tips. Camera/display-session persistence is not certified by this audit.

Choose Create sketch, then wait for the attached sketch edit session. Finish validates the whole document and accepts its actions; there is no separate creation Apply.

families.title: Trim, split, fillet/chamfer, extend and spline tasks
prerequisites: Active native sketch session. Select internal geometry or an exposed native control, not a projected curve.
selection: Fillet/Chamfer: one internal endpoint, or two whole curves with picked positions. Extend: line/arc endpoint. Split: activate Split curve and pick the curve position.
Spline tasks: whole internal spline, or exposed pole circle for weight editing. Carbon Copy uses another same-document sketch.
inputs: Fillet/Chamfer: Radius, each of two curve pick positions when applicable, Trim original curves, Preserve construction corner.
Extend: Length extension for a line or Angular extension for an arc. Carbon Copy: Source sketch, Construction geometry.
Spline degree: Degree change. Knots: Insert knot toggles parameter/multiplicity versus native 1-based knot index/multiplicity change.
Spline pole position: 1-based Pole selector and X (mm)/Y (mm) controls in the sketch frame. Weight: Pole, Dimensionless weight, explicitly selected native Equal constraints to release.

steps.instruction: Choose Edit tools task after selecting its inputs. Trim and Split instead pick the segment/position directly. Escape ends the picking tool.

Edit every relevant task field, inspect Recompute preview, then Apply one sketch action or Cancel to its baseline. Radius seeds a sketch fillet; add a native radius dimension to drive it later. Native spline degree reduction/knot reduction may replace or approximate geometry and remove constraints; inspect the returned snapshot.

Inspect the native candidate and error message. Recompute preview retries a complete candidate. If the task says Apply updates the model, Cancel keeps Redo, no native preview has run; Apply still requires native validation.
Task forms Apply accepts one native sketch action. Trim and Split instead commit the clicked segment/position directly, with no task Apply. Inspect reindexed native geometry and constraints.

Task Cancel restores its captured baseline. Escape stops Trim/Split picking, retaining earlier accepted actions until action Undo or session Cancel. In-flight calls temporarily disable task submissions.

Coincident accepts point relations; Point on object takes a point and whole curve. Symmetric needs a supported native point/axis combination. Fix maps to native Block.
Tangent and Perpendicular also accept two whole curves plus an exposed point in any point position; curve order remains selected order.

steps.instruction: Select the compatible native points/curves, open Constrain, hover a disabled command for its reason, then choose the enabled relation.

The relation commits one atomic native action. Inspect remaining freedom and constraints. Select a constraint row to highlight its actual entities; edit its name/state or delete it. Correct solver conflicts in the current sketch before Finish.
Geometric constraints use one atomic native action and no dimension or preview dialog. Native solver output is authoritative.
Choose the enabled Constrain command to commit it directly. Rename, Active, Driving and Delete constraint also submit native actions; there is no separate relation Apply.
Before choosing the command, change the picks or dismiss the menu. After success use sketch-action Undo or session Cancel. A failed relation leaves the accepted sketch available for repair.

families.title: Dimensions, expressions and measured angles
prerequisites: Active native sketch, no drag/task/dimension submission; compatible selected entities.
selection: D/Smart dimension chooses a supported length, radius or angle. Explicit menu choices are Length, Horizontal distance, Vertical distance, Radius, Diameter, Angle and Refraction ratio n2/n1.

Length also measures arc length or circle-boundary clearance. Angle measures an arc span or two curves. Angle through a point uses two whole curves and one exposed point; native X/Y axes are curve identities.
Refraction: two straight-ray endpoints in n1 then n2 order and a whole boundary curve. Repeated Shift-click selects coincident handles.
inputs: Datum text with compatible native units. Ordinary new dimensions first accept a datum; reopen the created dimension for its Expression checkbox. Existing dimensions and AngleViaPoint preparation expose Expression where applicable.

task_queue.title: Sketch creation lacks standalone orientation/support controls
task_queue.next_action: Preserve automatic first Body and atomic origin-plane creation. Add declared support/orientation/reverse/offset choices only against native attachment semantics. Keep chooser Cancel write-free and Redo-safe.

task_queue.candidate_note: Owner reports implementation in progress. Baseline absence remains accurate; coordinate review and missing gates rather than duplicating candidate implementation.

performance_policy.hillclimbing: Only after verified functional parity. Do not begin performance optimization from finite workflow passes or catalog coverage.
performance_policy.during_implementation: Correctness, native-baseline comparisons and representative resource/reliability regression gates remain required while functionality is built.
correctness_gates: All applicable original G1-G8 gates for every declared requirement, including actual UI delivery, parent changes, failure correction, native history and independent saved reopen.
Keep authoritative native geometry/solver, revision/lease guards, atomic failures, saved data and source preservation.
benchmark_planning: Record exact source/runtime/platform/workload and matched native baseline before measurement.
Plan cold/warm startup, working/peak memory, idle CPU, preview cancellation, regeneration and input-to-frame latency on representative moderate parts/assemblies.
Keep headless timing separate from desktop interaction. Report variance and native unsupported cases. Regression measurement does not authorize hillclimbing.
